from solution import set_left_most_unset_bit


def test_issue_example_10():
    """Example: set_left_most_unset_bit(10) == 14."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(10) == 14  # 0b1110 = 8+4+2 = 14


def test_issue_zero_becomes_one():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0 becomes 1."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(0) == 1  # 0b1 = 1


def test_issue_two_becomes_three():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b10 becomes 0b11."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(2) == 3  # 0b11 = 2+1 = 3


def test_issue_five_becomes_seven():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b101 becomes 0b111."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(5) == 7  # 0b111 = 4+2+1 = 7


def test_issue_six_becomes_seven():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b110 becomes 0b111."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(6) == 7  # 0b111 = 4+2+1 = 7


def test_issue_nine_becomes_thirteen():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b1001 becomes 0b1101."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(9) == 13  # 0b1101 = 8+4+1 = 13


def test_issue_twelve_becomes_fourteen():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b1100 becomes 0b1110."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(12) == 14  # 0b1110 = 8+4+2 = 14


def test_issue_power_of_two_eight():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b1000 becomes 0b1100."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(8) == 12  # 0b1100 = 8+4 = 12


def test_issue_larger_pattern_eighteen():
    """Rule: set the leftmost unset bit, so 0b10010 becomes 0b11010."""
    assert set_left_most_unset_bit(18) == 26  # 0b11010 = 16+8+2 = 26


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Contract: set_left_most_unset_bit returns an int."""
    assert isinstance(set_left_most_unset_bit(10), int)  # input 10 = 8+2


def test_contract_adds_exactly_one_bit():
    """Contract: setting one bit adds exactly one 1-bit."""
    n = 12  # 8+4 = 12
    r = set_left_most_unset_bit(n)
    assert bin(r).count("1") == bin(n).count("1") + 1  # 2+1 = 3 ones


def test_contract_all_ones_never_clears():
    """Contract: with no unset bit, no set bit is cleared."""
    n = 7  # 4+2+1 = 7
    r = set_left_most_unset_bit(n)
    assert (r & n) == n  # 7 stays with all bits set
